'''2007 Worlds Team Joseph Graham DS My Kind Of Scum''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joseph Graham]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif|label=My Kind Of Scum}}
* '''Stage:''' Team
